question: Which of the following was a play based on the love story of King Dushyant written by Kalidasa in the Gupta period?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Abhijnana Shakuntala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Abhijnana Shakuntala** is a Sanskrit play written by the renowned classical poet and dramatist **Kalidasa** during the **Gupta period**.
 
• The play is based on the love story of **King Dushyant** and **Shakuntala**, a maiden born to sage Vishwamitra and the celestial nymph Mena
